title: Rooftop jet route to roof loot
behaviors: Roof jet route: where the champion would only hold (or its farm/loot goal is itself on a roof) and farmOk holds, from t >= 10 s, with no supply drop announced/falling within DROP_RUN_M (200 m) and never in a drop run, drop ring hold or farm capture hold, walk to the ground beside the roof item's wall, jump and jet onto the roof (climbs capped at 48 m above our feet), and take the crate (broken by the existing farm shot), cube or wanted weapon. 3 s no-progress give-up per phase, wait/crate/trip caps, skip list.
champion_note: P40b = rebuild of P40 on the current champion P34 (code 0e6fadd, merged as 8c130ad, main 588557e, LETHAL_RELEASE_ON=true, site 4.38 BB-ABEB42BF). Bot code re-applied from /workspace/patches/p40-bot.diff (old commit 57e4bad, narrow-gate cut on the P29 base), same behavior. All runs TREES-ON (builder-sim-trees --trees), bases 0, 1000, 6000, 7000.
drop_gate: NARROW gate (Coordinator rule, /workspace/drop-gate-rule.txt): never while a drop run (dropRun/dropMove), drop ring hold (dropHold) or farm capture hold (farmHold) is on, and never while a drop is announced/falling (lands_in > 0) within DROP_RUN_M; a landed claimable drop in reach starts the drop run, which ranks above this and takes over on the same tick. Never 'no drop on the map' (that gate never opens in this sim: an untaken drop sits in obs.drops almost all game; killed P26b, P33, P29b).
brief: Single change: plan a jet/jump climb onto a roof (≤ ~60 m reachable with 100 energy, protocol.md:282-287) to take crates/loot that spawn on roofs (about a quarter of them), when no enemy is in view and the zone allows. The champion's nav is ground-only (nav.ts:16-17); jets are used only as a stuck escape (brain.ts:875-877). It must be separate from B125's TAC_JET_LOOT (site 3.50 bundled pack): explain how it differs. Early activation count first (stop under 10/192), then the full BUILD_CHECKLIST, with a flag-ON head.
differs_from_B125: B125 (PR #135, ec50d23, site 3.50 BB-C6A19503, CLOSE) bundled six flags (TAC_SPACE_EARLY, TAC_FIRE_MOVE, TAC_DODGE, TAC_JET_LOOT, TAC_LASER_REACH, TAC_FINISH_AMMO) on the old 4.17 main, so jet loot was never measured alone. Its TAC_JET_LOOT was a reactive hop on goals the old champion had already picked (a laser/lightning rush target, or a farm cube/drop in view within 80 m) that had no ground path or sat >= 4 m up: follow the ground route to 12 m, go straight at it, jump at any edge above step_up and jet until the feet clear it, with no target choice of its own, no roof crates, no memory, no climb spot, no energy wait, no t >= 10 s gate and no drop gate. P40 is one flag on the champion (P29 for the first build, P34 for P40b) with its own target choice: roof crates (none in B125), roof cubes and wanted roof weapons, remembered after they leave view, chosen only where the champion would hold (or its own goal is on a roof); it plans a climb spot on open ground beside the building wall (16-bearing edge search, no taller block between), walks there on a nav path, waits for 1.75 energy per metre + 15 (max 48 m), jets the full wall height, then stands by a crate while the existing farm shot breaks it; gated t >= 10 s, farmOk, narrow drop gate (no drop announced/falling within DROP_RUN_M, no drop run or ring hold); per-phase 3 s no-progress give-up, wait/crate/trip caps and a skip list.

Nothing else changes.
